component.name: SidebarNav
component.description: The fixed 220px left rail — brand mark, a 5-item nav list, and a footer disclosure. The one persistent app-level navigation surface.

commonPatterns.name: app-shell-nav
commonPatterns.description: One instance per page render, rendered alongside the main panel.

antiPatterns.scenario: Rendering more than one SidebarNav instance per page
antiPatterns.reason: it is the one persistent app-level navigation surface
antiPatterns.alternative: Use detail-breadcrumb-style contextual navigation for secondary nav (e.g. inside a detail page)

antiPatterns.scenario: Giving an unbuilt route a real href just to look consistent

antiPatterns.alternative: Omit href — the item renders inert automatically
